fit.method: staged bounded TRF: rubber_calibration_fit.fit_staged (code commits 015af80, 96ec658), script scripts/rubber/p2_5/run_fit_v2.py
fit.deterministic_rule: Warp 1.17 DeterministicMode.RUN_TO_RUN was tried and is refused at compile time by the frozen Phase 1 kernel tlmpm_v5._particle_contacts (mixed add / max atomics on one array); no cheap deterministic mode exists without editing frozen code, so the default (non-deterministic float atomics) GPU mode is used and the FD step is chosen against the measured noise
fit.fd_rule: Measured on the pilot at theta_pilot (v2_repeatability.py, 3 identical envs x 2 runs per fit experiment): rms spread of the weighted residuals 1.8e-7...5.3e-6 for T1 / T2 / R1 / C1 / G1 and 3.9e-4 for F1 (contact); rms FD signal at h = 1e-3: weakest relevant 1.3e-4 (G1 g1 / tau1), F1 tau1 7.4e-4 / tau2 8.2e-4. Rule: h = 1e-2 in u, so that for every (experiment, parameter that affects it) the rms FD residual change is >= 10x the rms GPU spread (F1 tau columns ~19x, every other pair >= 100x).
fit.bounds: the u-image of the v1 prior box (mu_eq log [2e5, 3.5e5] Pa, g1 logit(g1 / 0.5) [0.08, 0.2], g2 logit(g2 / (0.5 - g1)) [0.06 / 0.42, 0.15 / 0.30], tau1 log [5, 15] ms, tau2 log [60, 200] ms, mu_table [0.4, 0.6]); the hidden truth lies inside it by construction
fit.start: the prior-box centre (geometric mean for mu_eq, tau1, tau2; arithmetic mean for g1, g2, mu_table)

stages_formal.name: S2_visco
stages_formal.start_design: Latin hypercube over the stage box, numpy default_rng(2513 + stage index 1), lockstep

stages_formal.name: S4_joint_polish
stages_formal.experiments: the whole fit split (T1, T2, R1, C1, G1, F1)

fit.stage_rule: each stage fits its parameters with the others fixed at the current estimate, on its experiments only; the stage result is its best evaluated point; S2 uses visco information from relaxation and the fast tensile test (the cantilever enters in the joint polish, where the estimate is already close; trajectory matching of a ~4-period oscillation from a far start is the suspected cause of the v1 stall); the theta_hat is the best evaluated point of S4 on the whole fit split, its Jacobian (from the same population) gives the covariance
fit.starts_justification: S2 is the only stage with several nonlinear parameters before the cantilever enters; 3 starts there (lockstep, cheap tensile / relaxation records). S1 and S3 are one-dimensional and monotone in their data; S4 starts at the staged estimate.
fit.budget_rule: Budget per fit counted on the run's OWN GPU-lock hold time (run_fit_v2.py takes the blocking flock on rcs_rl_runner/gpu0.lock per forward evaluation and releases it in between so that queued jobs interleave; waiting time is not counted). A new forward population is not started when elapsed + the duration of the previous population would exceed the budget; the remaining stages are then skipped, except that the final stage always runs at least one population (the full residual and Jacobian at the current estimate). When the budget is exhausted the best iterate so far of the final stage IS the fit result and is scored normally against the frozen thresholds: CAL-04..CAL-07 then get PASS or FAIL, never NOT_RUN for budget reasons. The duration of the previous population is carried across stages; the budget can therefore be exceeded by at most the guaranteed final-stage population.
fit.cmaes: OPTIONAL comparison, reported only, run only if it fits the remaining GPU budget; otherwise reported as NOT_RUN (budget).
fit.device: GPU0 only, blocking flock per forward evaluation (not for the whole fit), >= 4 GB free checked after every acquisition; the process keeps its CUDA context and batch memory between evaluations; GPU1 is not used; PID 642659 untouched

cal_changes.CAL-04: pass: chi2_reduced(theta_hat) <= 1.5 x chi2_pilot (= 1.9097, unchanged) AND the S4 stage terminated by scipy's xtol / ftol / gtol criterion, by its max_nfev, or by the budget rule (status reported)
cal_changes.CAL-07: the negative control uses stages_negative_control (fit on T2 + C1 only) with the budget above; must FAIL CAL-05 on at least one held-out viscous metric (M1, M2, M5 or M6), else CAL-07 FAILs
cal_changes.CAL-08: order: v1 protocol < pilot < thresholds < formal dataset + manifest freeze < v2 protocol commit (after the v1 fit was stopped without a receipt, unseen) < v2 fit receipt commit < one-shot held-out < reveal

run_order_note: Corrected order (orchestrator decision 2026-11-12): formal fit -> commit its receipt -> negative-control fit -> commit its receipt -> ONE held-out call scoring both receipts -> reveal -> recovery -> evidence. Reason: evaluate_heldout is one-shot per manifest freeze and scores every committed receipt in one call; a negative-control held-out after the primary one would have to be a labelled audit re-run, and a negative-control fit after the reveal would be fitted with the truth known.
